title: Red Breakthrough
description: Adversary achieves initial execution via synthetic spearphish, discovers privileged accounts, pivots laterally via SMB, and reaches finance database before containment.

detail.title: Directory Enumeration
detail.description: Synthetic crawler probes publicly exposed endpoints for employee email formats.
detail.log: mail-gw.fintechcorp.local: TLS handshakes from 198.51.100.44:49210 rate 32 req/s
detail.attackerMove: Adversary sweeps external mail gateway for naming conventions.
detail.defenderDetect: Rate anomalies on edge SMTP logs and TLS handshake bursts.
detail.attackerAdapt: Slow down probe rate or rotate external proxy IPs to evade threshold alarms.

detail.title: Spearphishing Attachment
detail.description: Targeted lookalike payroll notification delivered to finance operator workstation.
detail.log: ws-402 winlogon: Process excel.exe spawned synthetic powershell.exe -NonI -Enc (flagged)
detail.attackerMove: Delivers deceptive spreadsheet targeting finance operator.
detail.defenderDetect: EDR detects Excel executing non-interactive script interpreter.
detail.attackerAdapt: Use HTML smuggling or signed living-off-the-land binaries (LOLBins).

detail.title: EDR Process Tree Alert
detail.description: SOC alert queue receives high-severity notification: uncharacteristic child process under office app.
detail.log: SOC-ALERT [HIGH]: Suspicious process execution ws-402: cmdline token match regex /enc/i
detail.attackerMove: Adversary executes preliminary in-memory payload on workstation.
detail.defenderDetect: Behavioral rule matching office suite child processes spawning script hosts.
detail.attackerAdapt: Adversary injects into running explorer.exe thread immediately upon spawn.

detail.title: Initial Foothold & Credential Harvest
detail.description: Adversary dumps local LSASS cache (synthetic simulation) to retrieve cached domain tokens.
detail.cmd: [creds] dump memory space PID 684 (synthetic minidump simulation) -> 1 token found
detail.log: ws-402 Security-Auditing 4624: Special logon granted for SVC-BACKUP (elevated)
detail.attackerMove: Adversary extracts cached backup credentials from compromised workstation memory.
detail.defenderDetect: Access handle requests to lsass.exe process with PROCESS_VM_READ mask.
detail.attackerAdapt: Avoid lsass dumping by targeting browser credential stores or DPAPI tokens.

detail.title: Lateral Movement via SMB
detail.description: Adversary utilizes stolen service account credentials to establish remote service on dc-01.
detail.log: dc-01 Security-Auditing 7045: A service was installed in the system: svc-diag32 (synthetic)
detail.attackerMove: Pivots laterally from workstation to domain controller using admin share.
detail.defenderDetect: Event ID 7045 from non-management IP address subnet.
detail.attackerAdapt: Leverage WMI or WinRM with legitimate admin tooling rather than raw SMB service creation.

detail.title: Reaching Finance Vault
detail.description: Adversary accesses high-value ledger database server srv-fin01.fintechcorp.local.
detail.log: srv-fin01 LedgerDB Audit: SELECT * FROM synthetic_customers_ledger LIMIT 1000
detail.attackerMove: Connects directly to internal finance database server from internal foothold.
detail.defenderDetect: Direct database connection initiated from workstation rather than app tier.
detail.attackerAdapt: Tunnel query traffic through approved web application server via SQL injection.

detail.title: Network Containment & Token Revocation
detail.description: SOC issues micro-segmentation isolation rule on ws-402 and revokes SVC-BACKUP Kerberos tickets.
detail.cmd: pve-firewall ipset add quarantined_hosts 10.0.2.42; klist purge /user:SVC-BACKUP
detail.log: Proxmox SDN: Rule applied - DROP ALL IN/OUT ws-402 (10.0.2.42) except SOC tap 10.0.99.1
detail.attackerMove: Adversary attempts persistent C2 heartbeat from ws-402.
detail.defenderDetect: Immediate TCP RST on command-and-control beacon and host isolation.
detail.attackerAdapt: Attempt secondary backdoor channel via DNS tunneling or fallback scheduled task.

decisionPoints.prompt: EDR detected anomalous script execution on ws-402.fintechcorp.local. What is your containment action?

options.label: Isolate host ws-402 via SDN & preserve memory
options.feedback: Host isolated within 14s. Cut adversary lateral movement path before credential dump.

options.label: Restart workstation ws-402 to clear process
options.feedback: Reboot wiped volatile RAM evidence while adversary persistence survived in run-keys.

options.label: Block sender domain only on mail gateway
options.feedback: Sender blocked for new emails, but active in-memory payload on ws-402 continued unhindered.

decisionPoints.prompt: Lateral movement detected on dc-01 via SMB Admin Share. How do you respond?

options.label: Revoke Kerberos TGT & force domain-wide reset of SVC-BACKUP
options.feedback: Invalidated attacker ticket cache immediately, preventing access to ledger database.

options.label: Disconnect DC-01 completely from the network
options.feedback: Dropping the DC caused full enterprise authentication outage across fintechcorp.local.

options.label: Queue full disk antivirus scan on dc-01
options.feedback: Traditional file scan took 45 minutes; attacker memory injection was not intercepted.

review.lesson: Fast host isolation at the initial compromise stage prevents lateral SMB pivoting to high-value domain controllers.
